_comment: Nine cases from real CDC traffic, labelled by Manu on 2026-09-15: six were
correct, three were false positives. They exist so a prompt change can be
measured instead of hoped at - see scripts/whatsapp-eval.js.
Staff and customer names are generalised because this file lives in git
forever. Machine names are kept: that vocabulary is exactly what the
Cases carry a `kind`: 'internal' (the default, omitted) or 'client'. A client
case is judged by client-prompt.md, which deliberately flags far more - an
unanswered customer question is a concern there and is not one internally.
Both prompts are exercised in one run so tightening one cannot quietly
Severity is CHECKED, not just noted: alerting now has a floor, so a concern
graded medium never reaches a phone. A prompt that finds the right problems
at the wrong severity would have passed this fixture before the floor and
gone silent in production after it.

cases.name: machine down, no response to repeated messages

messages.text: Sudarshan cutting machine abhi tak down hai, sirf Proteck cutter chal raha hai. Kal se bol rahe hain koi jawab nahi mila

cases.name: production halted by a broken lock

messages.text: machine ka lock tut gaya, production band hai

cases.name: photosensor fault, reported with a photo caption

messages.text: Eterna foil machine. stop photosel not working

cases.name: lift stopped, reported as a photo caption

messages.text: Lift stop please solve it

cases.name: material not received

messages.text: outer foam die abhi tak nahi aaya, die cutting ruka hua hai

cases.name: customer rejection

messages.text: customer ne 250 pcs boxes reject kar diye, ek piece repair karke reconfirm karwana hai

cases.name: FALSE POSITIVE: a standing instruction, not a fault

messages.text: Kongsberg plotter is not to be used for production jobs due to recurring faults. Instruction from management.

expect.why: telling people how to work is not a fault report, even though it exists because of past faults

cases.name: FALSE POSITIVE: planned maintenance announced in advance

messages.text: Mitsu press is going into maintenance from tomorrow and will be out of service for 4-5 days. Please do not commit delivery dates without discussion.

expect.why: a planned outage is information; it becomes a concern only when something actually slips

cases.name: FALSE POSITIVE: a request for contact

messages.text: Who is handling the MCC job? Please contact me immediately, it is urgent

expect.why: wanting an answer is not reporting a problem; 'immediately' and 'urgent' are phrasing, not evidence

cases.name: quiet chatter stays quiet

messages.text: good morning
aaj ka production 4200 pcs
ok thik hai

expect.why: greetings and production counts - the common case

cases.name: client says colour is not matching the approved proof

messages.text: Colour is not matching the proof we approved. Second time this is happening, kindly look into this.

cases.name: client chasing a dispatch date (was a pass before management tightened it)

messages.text: Any update on dispatch? We are still waiting.

expect.why: management rejected exactly this pattern: a first ask, or a status chase, is ordinary order traffic rather than something gone wrong

cases.name: client asks a plain question nobody has answered (was a pass before management tightened it)

messages.text: Who is handling this job now? Please ask him to call me.

expect.why: management rejected exactly this pattern: a first ask, or a status chase, is ordinary order traffic rather than something gone wrong

cases.name: client simply approving is not a concern

messages.text: Received, thanks. Approved for print.

expect.why: a customer confirming is the outcome we want, not a problem

cases.name: our own staff posting an update is not a concern

messages.text: Sir, proof sent on mail just now. Dispatch planned Thursday.

expect.why: CDC's own update is not a customer concern

cases.name: ADMIN REJECT: a first request from a customer

messages.text: Please deliver 5 pcs of jelly PR to the Kolkata office.

expect.why: asking for something is the job, not a problem with it

cases.name: ADMIN REJECT: coordination, not a fault

messages.text: I am coming to CDC with the items but cannot get a cab, need some help with the arrival.

expect.why: somebody sorting out a visit is not a concern

cases.name: ADMIN KEEP: a committed dispatch date slips by ten days

messages.text: Dispatch planned for 16/10/2026 is pushed to 26/10/2026 due to a sudden machine breakdown.

cases.name: ADMIN REJECT: a preference about how to send something

messages.text: Please inform us prior to sending the jellies and the merch.

expect.why: telling CDC how they would like it handled is information, not a fault

cases.name: ADMIN KEEP: material unavailable, production stuck

messages.text: Tray for the 250/500 laddu box forming is not available, production is stuck.

cases.name: ADMIN REJECT: a status chase, asked once

messages.text: We expect 150 pcs, yesterday's and today's, to be completed by tomorrow. Please confirm the status.

expect.why: wanting to know where something is, asked once, is normal traffic

cases.name: the same chase, repeated after silence, IS a concern

messages.text: Please confirm the status of the 150 pcs.
Still waiting for a reply on this. Third time I am asking.

expect.why: the line management drew: a first ask is routine, being ignored is not

cases.name: a machine down that somebody is already fixing is not high

messages.text: Aster 220 machine down
Fitter is looking at it now

expect.why: a plant getting on with its day - on the dashboard, not on a phone
